buttons.notes: Official spec confirms these two are the DPI Minus/Plus buttons, not generic 'top controls'; left-to-right physical order (whether G6 or G7 is Minus) is unconfirmed.

save.reason: Legacy G9x shell and macro storage require a dedicated legacy implementation

notes: The mapping is a conservative physical description for legacy discovery, not an authorization to write unknown macro records.

The two product IDs were inherited from a combined G9/G9x descriptor and are believed to be G9x's revisions (including the Signature Edition), but have not been independently re-verified against real devices.

DPI maximum corrected 5000 -> 5700: libratbag's logitech-g9x-Original.device (0xC066) declares DpiRange=200:5700@50 and logitech-g9x-Call-of-Duty-MW3-Edition.device (0xC249) declares DpiRange=0:5700@23.53 -- both cap at 5700, not 5000.

G6/G7 relabeled 2026-09-17 from generic 'Top control' to 'DPI down'/'DPI up': official Logitech G9x Technical Reference Document lists 'DPI Settings Buttons: Minus (-), Plus (+)', same shape as G9's spec page (confirmed only against PID 0xC066; 0xC249 is presumably a later board revision not covered by this specific page).
